name: Encave
storyline:
A cold and clinical biotech megacorporation specializing in the creation of living weapons.

Deep beneath the surface, Encave Corporation breeds living weapons. Most never make it to market.

Your job is to dispose of the failures...

As an Encave employee, you'll construct and upgrade deadly killrooms designed to eliminate rejected bioweapon specimens. Build defensive layouts using turrets, traps, mines, barricades, and reinforced walls while preparing for increasingly dangerous containment breaches.

No defense lasts forever...

Mutated creatures will smash through walls, destroy fortifications, and carve new paths toward your position. Every wave introduces deadlier specimens, forcing you to adapt your defenses and fight alongside the machines you've built.

Encave combines first-person shooter combat with strategic tower-defense gameplay. Shape the battlefield, create efficient killzones, and survive against relentless waves of corporate mistakes.
summary: Encave is a hybrid FPS-tower-defense game. Build customizable killrooms in a fully destructible environment to eliminate waves of corporate bioweapon rejects! Strategic base construction, and escalating Lovecraftian threats, Encave delivers a unique blend of action, strategy, and dark humor.
